fullContent:
Kasisadi Tailam (Oil) – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference: Bhaishajya Ratnavali Arsharogadhikara 111-113 
 Introduction 
 Kasisadi Tailam (Oil) is an Ayurvedic oil preparation which is used in the treatment of piles. It is only meant for external application over the piles. 
 Ingredients 
 12 grams of each of:- 
 
 Kasisa – Ferrous sulphate 
 Saindhava – Rock salt 
 Krishna – Piper longum 
 Shunti – Ginger – Zingiber officinalis 
 Kushta – Saussurea lappa 
 Langali – Gloriosa superba 
 Shilajatu – Asphaltum 
 Danti – Baliospermum montanum 
 Jantughna – Embelia ribes 
 Chitraka – Plumbago zeylanica 
 Haratala – Orpiment – Aresnic tri sulphide 
 Manashila – Realgar – Arsenis sulphide 
 Svarnakshiri – Argemone mexicana 
 Snuhi Paya – Latex of Euphorbia neriifolia 
 Arka Paya – Latex of Calotropis procera 
 Taila – Oil of Sesamum indicum – 768 ml 
 Gomutra – Cow urine – 3.072 liters 
 
 Indications 
 It is used in treating piles. It is applied externally over the pile mass. It shrinks the pile mass and is corrosive in nature. 
 How to Use? 
 For external use only. 
 It is used to apply over the pile mass, once or twice a day. 
 Side Effects 
 This product should only be used under strict medical supervision. 
 Special care is needed while applying this oil. 
 Note:- Oral intake should be avoided. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
